`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. Before this change, a missing id made `invoice.__dict__` fail on `None`, which gave a 500. I haven't run the code or any tests.

The 404 body is built with `problem()` from `src/api/errors.py`, as the project's problem+json convention requires. It has the title "Invoice not found" and a detail line naming the id.

I also added `from .errors import problem` to the imports. I assumed `src/api` is imported as a package. If it isn't, the relative import will fail.

I didn't save anything to EngramDB, since nothing durable came up beyond the existing problem+json convention.
